title: Kremlin adviser warns UK drone factories could face attacks
english: A Kremlin adviser has warned that drone manufacturing facilities in the UK could face potential attacks following Britain's decision to share missile blueprints with Ukraine. Moscow views this technology transfer as direct British military involvement in the ongoing conflict. While official Russian sources suggest these actions might involve cyberattacks or semi-military measures, the UK maintains that its support is a necessary response to Russia's invasion.
amharic: የክሬምሊን አማካሪ እንግሊዝ ለዩክሬን የሚሳኤል ዲዛይን ምስጢሮችን በማካፈሏ ምክንያት በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የሚገኙ የድሮን ፋብሪካዎች ጥቃት ሊሰነዘርባቸው እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ሞስኮ ይህ ድርጊት እንግሊዝ በቀጥታ በጦርነቱ ውስጥ እየተሳተፈች መሆኗን የሚያሳይ ማስረጃ ነው ብላ ታምናለች። ምንም እንኳን የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት ይህንን እንደ የሳይበር ጥቃት ወይም ከፊል ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ሊገልጹት ቢችሉም፣ እንግሊዝ የምትሰጠው ድጋፍ ለሩሲያ ወረራ የተሰጠ ምላሽ እንደሆነ ትገልጻለች።
oromo: Gorsaan biiroo Kremlin akka jedhutti, Biritishin mala meeshaa waraana fageenya dheeraa dhaqqabu (missile) waan Ukraine waliin qooddatteef, qorqobbiiwwan drone Biritish keessatti argaman miidhaa irra ga'uu danda'u jedheera. Moskoon tarkaanfiin kun Biritish kallattiin waraana kana keessatti hirmaachaa jirti jechuudha. Mootummaan Ruusiyaas tarkaanfiin kun haxxee kompiitaraa ykn tarkaanfii waraana wal-fakkaatu ta'uu akka danda'u ibsuus, Biritish garuu deeggarsa ishee waraana Ruusiyaan jalqabameef deebii kennamaa jiru akka ta'e dubbatti.

title: Who are Iran’s top trading partners US would need to target to isolate it?
english: The United States has launched a new campaign called Operation Economic Outcast, aiming to fully isolate Iran by imposing broad sanctions on its shipping, technology, and financial sectors. This strategy focuses on pressuring international partners to stop trading with Tehran, as Iran has increasingly relied on Asian and regional markets to bypass long-standing Western restrictions. Official data shows Iran maintains significant trade flows worth billions, which Washington now seeks to dismantle to sever the country's economic lifelines.
amharic: አሜሪካ ኢራንን ከአለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ ሙሉ ለሙሉ ለማግለል "ኦፕሬሽን ኢኮኖሚክ አውትካስት" የተሰኘ አዲስ ማዕቀብ ተግባራዊ አድርጋለች። ይህ ስትራቴጂ የኢራንን የመርከብ፣ የቴክኖሎጂ እና የፋይናንስ ዘርፎች ኢላማ በማድረግ ሌሎች ሀገራት ከቴህራን ጋር ያላቸውን የንግድ ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጡ ይገፋፋል። ኢራን ላለፉት ዓመታት በምዕራባውያን ማዕቀቦች ምክንያት የንግድ አጋሮቿን ወደ እስያ እና አካባቢው ሀገራት በማዞር ኢኮኖሚዋን ስትመራ ቆይታለች፣ አሁን ግን አሜሪካ እነዚህን የገቢ ምንጮች ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመዝጋት እየሰራች ነው።
oromo: Ameerikaan Iran dinagdee addunyaa irraa guutummaatti addaan baasuuf jecha "Operation Economic Outcast" kan jedhamu tarkaanfii sanadaa haaraa fudhattee jirti. Karoorri kun dameewwan markabaa, teknooloojii fi faayinaansii Iran irratti xiyyeeffachuun, biyyoonni addunyaa biroo Iran waliin daldala akka hin goone dhiibbaa taasisa. Iran waggoota hedduuf sababa sanadaa lixaa irraa dhufaniin daldala ishee gara biyyoota Eshiyaa fi naannawa ishee jijjiirattee turte, garuu amma Ameerikaan mala kana hundumaa cufuuf yaalii gochaa jirti.

title: ‘Enough is enough’: Kenya nurses strike over pay and working conditions
english: Thousands of nurses in Kenya have launched a strike to protest against inadequate wages and poor working conditions. The healthcare workers decided to take this action after multiple attempts to negotiate with authorities failed to address their concerns. They are now demanding better compensation and official recognition for the vital work they perform.
amharic: በኬንያ የሚገኙ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነርሶች ዝቅተኛ ደመወዝን እና አስቸጋሪ የስራ ሁኔታን በመቃወም አድማ መተው። የጤና ባለሙያዎቹ ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰኑት ከባለስልጣናት ጋር ያደረጓቸው ተከታታይ የድርድር ሙከራዎች ውጤት አልባ በመሆናቸው ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት ሰራተኞቹ ተገቢ የሆነ ክፍያ እና ሙያዊ እውቅና እንዲሰጣቸው እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hojjettoonni yaalaa kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman Keeniyaa keessatti kaffaltii gadi aanaa fi haala hojii mijaataa hin taane mormuun hojii dhaabaniiru. Hojjettoonni kunneen tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatan, mootummaa wajjin mariin taasisan furmaata waaraa waan hin arganneefidha. Amma guddina kaffaltii fi kabaja hojii isaaniif malu argachuuf gaaffii dhiyeessaa jiru.

title: Nvidia, Supermicro employees charged over export of AI servers to China
english: Taiwanese authorities have indicted nine individuals, including workers from Nvidia and Supermicro, for illegally smuggling advanced AI servers to China. The group reportedly bypassed export restrictions by shipping the hardware through countries like Indonesia and Japan. Prosecutors are now seeking jail time for those involved, highlighting a need for stricter laws regarding the export of sensitive semiconductor technology.
amharic: የታይዋን ባለስልጣናት የላቁ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ሰርቨሮችን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ወደ ቻይና በመላክ ወንጀል የኤንቪዲያ እና የሱፐር ማይክሮ ሰራተኞችን ጨምሮ ዘጠኝ ሰዎችን ክስ መስርተውባቸዋል። የተጠረጠሩት ግለሰቦች የቴክኖሎጂ መሳሪያዎቹን እንደ ኢንዶኔዢያ እና ጃፓን ባሉ ሀገራት በኩል በማዘዋወር የአሜሪካን የኤክስፖርት ገደብ ለመጣስ ሞክረዋል። አቃቤ ህጎች በተከሰሱት ሰዎች ላይ የእስር ቅጣት እንዲጣል እየጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በታይዋን የቴክኖሎጂ ኤክስፖርት ህጎች ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ ውይይት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa biyya Taayiwaan, hojjettoota dhaabbata Nvidia fi Supermicro dabalatee namoota sagal, sarvaroota AI gurguddaa ta'an seeraan alaa gara Chaayinaatti erguun himatanii jiru. Namoonni himataman kun meeshaalee teeknoolojii kana akka Indoneesiyaa fi Jaappaan jiran keessa dabarsuudhaan dhorkaa gurgurtaa Ameerikaan kaa'e cabsuu isaanii ibsameera. Abbaan alangaa namoota kana irratti adabbii hidhaa gaafachaa jiru; kunis teeknoolojii semiconductors irratti seera cimaa baasuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's democratic progress is hindered by deep-seated social patterns that prioritize strict obedience over open dialogue. From childhood and family life to schools and workplaces, citizens are often taught that questioning authority is a sign of disloyalty. This ingrained culture of hierarchy discourages critical thinking and collective cooperation, making it difficult to build a truly participatory democratic society.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዴሞክራሲ ጉዞ በህብረተሰቡ ውስጥ ስር በሰደደ እና ታዛዥነትን ከሁሉም በላይ በሚያስቀድም የአስተሳሰብ ዘይቤ ተደናቅፏል። ከቤተሰብ ጀምሮ በትምህርት ቤቶችና በሥራ ቦታዎች ስልጣንን መጠየቅ እንደ ታማኝነት ማጉደል ስለሚታይ፣ ሰዎች ሃሳባቸውን በነፃ ከመግለጽ ይቆጠባሉ። ይህ የተለመደ የሥልጣን ተዋረድ አድናቆት የፈጠረው ባህል፣ ለዴሞክራሲያዊ ውይይትና ለጋራ መግባባት ትልቅ እንቅፋት ሆኗል።
oromo: Demokiraasiin Itoophiyaa keessatti akka hin dagaagne kan godhu, hawaasa keessatti aadaa abboommii cimaa fi gaaffii kaasuu akka yakkaatti ilaaluudha. Ijoollummaadhaa kaasee mana keessatti, mana barnootaatti fi iddoo hojiitti, nama aangoo qabu mormuun akka tuffiitti fudhatama. Amalli kun yaada bilisaa fi marii irratti kan hundaa'e tokkummaa waan daangessuuf, jijjiirama demokiraasii dhugaa fiduun ulfaataa ta'eera.

title: Pakistan says significant progress made in talks on Iran-US war
english: High-level Pakistani officials, including the army chief and interior minister, visited Tehran to mediate a resolution to the ongoing conflict between Iran and the US. During these discussions, both nations explored ways to de-escalate tensions, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and revive a previous peace framework known as the Islamabad MoU. While Iranian leadership emphasized that the US must change its coercive approach, Pakistani representatives reported that the talks were highly positive and productive.

Preezidaantiin Iraan Ameerikaan adeemsa ishee jijjiiruu akka qabdu yoo ibsan, gamni Paakistaan garuu mariin kun bu'a qabeessaafi abdii gaariidhaan xumuramuusaa beeksisaniiru.

title: Rohingya refugees protest, nine years after exodus to Bangladesh
english: Rohingya refugees living in Bangladesh recently held protests to mark the nine-year anniversary of their mass departure from Myanmar. The demonstrators gathered to demand justice and international recognition for the violence and alleged genocide they endured. They remain trapped in the world's largest refugee camp, continuing to seek accountability for the tragedy that forced them to flee their homes.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በሚገኙ መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች የሚኖሩ የሮሂንጋ ስደተኞች ከሚናማር የተሰደዱበት ዘጠነኛ ዓመት በማስመልከት የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ስደተኞቹ በደረሰባቸው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ፍትህ እንዲሰፍን እና አለም አቀፍ ትኩረት እንዲሰጣቸው ጠይቀዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በዓለማችን ትልቁ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ውስጥ የሚገኙት እነዚህ ሰዎች ለተፈናቀሉበት ግፍ ተጠያቂነት እንዲኖር መጠየቃቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Baqattoonni Rohingyaa baqattota biyya Baangilaadesh keessatti argaman, waggaa sagal dura biyya Maayaanmaar irraa arii'amanii bahuu isaanii yaadachuuf hiriira mormii gaggeessaniiru. title: Strait of Hormuz tanker traffic falls to lowest level since May
english: Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz dropped significantly on Monday, with only two commodity tankers passing through, marking the lowest daily count since May. This figure is a sharp decline from the typical average of 14 vessels recorded over the previous ten days. Shipping experts also reported a notable decrease in the total volume of daily oil flows passing through this critical maritime route.

Akkasumas, hanga boba'aa daandii kana irratti darbuus akka hir'ate odeeffannoon ni addeessa.

title: Colombia lifts coal export ban on Israel imposed over Gaza genocide
english: The new Colombian administration has reversed a coal export ban to Israel that was originally implemented by the previous government to protest the conflict in Gaza. Government officials recently announced the authorization of these shipments, although specific details regarding the timeline or regulatory requirements remain undisclosed. This move marks a significant shift in policy compared to the previous administration, which had even severed diplomatic ties with Israel.

title: Global ocean temperatures hit record high as El Nino intensifies
english: Global sea surface temperatures have reached an all-time high, surpassing previous records set in 2024. Experts from the Copernicus Climate Change Service attribute this rise to a combination of long-term human-induced climate change and the strengthening El Nino weather phenomenon. This unusual warming, occurring well outside the typical peak season, poses severe threats to marine ecosystems, coastal communities, and global food security.

title: Thai vendor confronts Israeli tourists, raises Palestinian flag
english: A street vendor in Phuket, Thailand, was filmed confronting a group of Israeli tourists by waving a Palestinian flag and shouting pro-Palestinian slogans. The shopkeeper ordered the group to leave his premises after alleging that one of the tourists had previously provoked him by yelling in support of Israel. The incident highlights the localized impact of the ongoing Middle East conflict on public interactions abroad.

title: Hasina spat stalls Bangladesh-India reset. What would break the deadlock?
english: Diplomatic efforts to mend relations between Bangladesh and India have hit a standstill following a press conference held by ousted leader Sheikh Hasina from her exile in New Delhi. The Bangladeshi government is frustrated that India allowed Hasina to criticize their new leadership, leading to the postponement of Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s planned visit. Experts suggest that India must prevent Hasina from engaging in political activities from its territory to resolve the current tension and move forward.

title: Muslims are not creating an 'Islamic Republic' in Britain. This is their home
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently sparked controversy by baselessly labeling Britain an 'Islamic Republic.' This claim ignores the fact that British Muslims are a small, integrated minority contributing to a diverse democracy, while leaders of other faiths have never been subjected to similar accusations. There is no evidence of a political movement to establish Islamic rule in the country, and such rhetoric is merely a form of anti-Muslim fear-mongering.

title: Federer to play tennis at US Open but rules out Williams-like return
english: Tennis legend Roger Federer is returning to Arthur Ashe Stadium for an exhibition event, marking his first appearance at the venue since 2019. Despite his return for these matches, the 45-year-old athlete clarified that he has no intention of making a professional comeback. He is visiting New York briefly before heading to Rhode Island to be inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከብ ሮጀር ፌደረር ከ2019 በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በዩኤስ ኦፕን የቴኒስ ውድድር ማሳያ ዝግጅት ላይ ለመሳተፍ ወደ አርተር አሽ ስታዲየም ተመልሷል። የ45 ዓመቱ አትሌት ለእነዚህ ጨዋታዎች ቢገኝም ወደ ፕሮፌሽናል ውድድር የመመለስ ዕቅድ እንደሌለው በግልጽ ተናግሯል። ወደ ኢንተርናሽናል ቴኒስ ዝና ማዕከል (Hall of Fame) ከመግባቱ በፊት ለጉብኝት በኒውዮርክ ይገኛል።

Umuriin isaa waggaa 45 kan ta'e atleetichi, qophii kanarratti hirmaatus gara dorgommii ogeessotaa deebi'uuf akka hin yaadne ibseera. Innis mana qophii 'International Tennis Hall of Fame' keessatti galmaa'uuf osoo hin deemin dura dhaabbata yeroof Niiw Yuork galee jira.

title: The Iran war is bringing cyberwarfare into critical infrastructure
english: Recent cyberattacks on power plants in the UK and water systems across the United States highlight the growing risk of digital warfare targeting essential infrastructure. While these incidents have caused limited physical damage so far, they signal a dangerous shift from data theft to the potential disruption of vital services like energy and water supply. Governments and businesses worldwide must urgently strengthen their security measures to protect the physical systems that keep society running.

Hojiiwwan kun hanga ammaatti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu baatanis, xiyyeeffannoon namoota badii hojjetanii seeraan alaa ragaa hatuu qofa osoo hin taane, tajaajiloota akka bishaanii fi elektirikii addaan kutuu irratti akka ta'e agarsiisa. title: Fulham vs Chelsea: Alonso starts new era with thrilling 3–2 win
english: Chelsea began their season with a narrow 3-2 victory over Fulham in Xabi Alonso's first match as head coach. Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers, and Cole Palmer scored for Chelsea, with Palmer netting the opening goal just 31 seconds into the game. Although Fulham fought back with two goals, they were unable to equalize, allowing Chelsea to secure all three points in this intense London derby.
amharic: ቼልሲ በዣቢ አሎንሶ አሰልጣኝነት ባደረገው የመጀመሪያ የሊግ ጨዋታ ፉልሃምን 3 ለ 2 በሆነ ውጤት አሸንፏል። ዣኦ ፔድሮ፣ ሞርጋን ሮጀርስ እና ኮል ፓልመር ለቼልሲ ግቦቹን ያስቆጠሩ ሲሆን፣ ፓልመር ጨዋታው እንደተጀመረ በ31ኛው ሰከንድ የመጀመሪያውን ጎል አስቆጥሯል። ፉልሃም ሁለት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር ተፎካካሪነቱን ቢያሳይም፣ ቼልሲ ውጤቱን በማስጠበቅ የለንደን ደርቢውን በድል አጠናቋል።
oromo: Chelsiin leenjisaa haaraa Xaabii Alonsoo jalatti taphuma isaa jalqabaa liigii kanaa Fulham irratti 3-2 injifannoon xumureera. Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers fi Cole Palmer gola Chelsiif kan lakkoofsisan yoo ta'u, Palmer taphichi jalqabee sekondii 31n gola jalqabaa galcheera. Fulham goolii lama lakkoofsisuun mormii cimaa godhus, Chelsiin injifannoo isaa itti fufuun qabxii guutuu fudhachuu danda'eera.

title: Angel Reese breaks WNBA record with 26 rebounds in Dream’s win over Sparks
english: Atlanta Dream forward Angel Reese made WNBA history by setting a new single-game record with 26 rebounds during a 78-71 victory over the Los Angeles Sparks. In addition to this feat, she also surpassed the league's single-season rebounding record and achieved her 27th double-double of the year. Her impressive performance helped secure another win for the Dream, further cementing her status as one of the league's most dominant rebounders.
amharic: የአትላንታ ድሪም ተጫዋች የሆነችው ኤንጀል ሪስ በሎስ አንጀለስ ስፓርክስ ላይ በተደረገው ጨዋታ 26 ጊዜ ኳሶችን በመቀማት አዲስ የWNBA የነጠላ ጨዋታ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግባለች። ከዚህ ታሪካዊ ውጤት በተጨማሪ፣ የሊጉን የአንድ የውድድር ዘመን የኳስ መቀማት ክብረ ወሰን የሰበረች ሲሆን የዘንድሮውን 27ኛ ድርብ-ድርብ ውጤቷንም አስመዝግባለች። ይህ አስደናቂ ብቃቷ ቡድኗ ድል እንዲቀዳጅ ትልቅ አስተዋፅዖ አድርጓል።
oromo: Taphattuun garee Atlanta Dream, Angel Reese, tapha Los Angeles Sparks waliin taasisaniin kubbaa 26 harkisuun seenaa WNBA haaraa galteetti. Galata kana cinaatti, rekardii kubbaa harkisuu bara kanaa kan diigdee fi 'double-double' 27ffaa ishee galmeessiteetti. Gumaachi isheen tapha kana irratti taasiste gareen ishee 78-71 akka injifatu taasiseera.

title: Libya factions draft initial election pact amid lingering mistrust
english: Libyan representatives from the east and west have signed a preliminary agreement to establish election laws and reform the national voting commission. Despite this progress, significant obstacles remain, including strong opposition from various political factions and legal uncertainties regarding the deal's implementation. Experts warn that deep-seated mistrust and disagreements over interim governance continue to threaten the success of the peace process.
amharic: የሊቢያ የምስራቅ እና ምዕራብ ተወካዮች የምርጫ ህጎችን ለማውጣት እና የብሄራዊ ምርጫ ኮሚሽንን ለማሻሻል የሚያስችል የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ሂደት ተስፋ ሰጪ ቢሆንም፣ በተለያዩ የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች ዘንድ ያለው ተቃውሞ እና የስምምነቱን አፈጻጸም የሚመለከቱ የህግ ክፍተቶች ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ በቡድኖቹ መካከል ያለው ጥልቅ አለመተማመን እና በሽግግር ወቅት ሀገሪቱን ማን መምራት እንዳለበት ያለው አለመግባባት የሰላም ሂደቱን ለአደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል።
oromo: Bakka buutonni Liibiya kan bahaa fi dhihaa, seerawwan filannoo baasuu fi komishinii filannoo biyyaalessaa fooyyessuuf waliigaltee jalqabaa mallatteessaniiru. Sochii kana keessa darbuuf rakkina guddaan kan jiru yoo ta'u, mormiin garee siyaasaa garaa garaa fi hanqinni seeraa hojiirra oolmaa waliigaltichaa irratti shakkii uumaa jira. Ogeeyyoonni akka ibsanitti, walitti bu'iinsa cimaa fi gareelee gidduutti amantaan dhabamuu akkasumas mootummaa cehuumsaa irratti waliigalteen dhabamuun isaa adeemsa nagaa biyyattii balaaf saaxilaa jira.

title: Saudi Arabia, France reaffirm support for Palestinian statehood
english: Saudi Arabia and France have officially reaffirmed their commitment to the creation of an independent Palestinian state. During meetings in Paris, the leaders of both nations urged an immediate halt to Israeli settlement expansion and violence against Palestinians. They emphasized that these actions jeopardize the long-term viability of a two-state solution.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፈረንሳይ የፍልስጤም መንግስት የመመስረት መብትን እንደሚደግፉ በድጋሚ ገልጸዋል። በፓሪስ በተደረገ ውይይት፣ የሁለቱ ሀገራት መሪዎች እስራኤል የምታደርገውን የሰፈራ መስፋፋት እና በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የሚፈጸመውን ጥቃት እንዲያቆሙ ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የሁለት ሀገር መፍትሄን አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaa fi Faransaayiin mootummaa Filisxeemii ijaaruuf deeggarsa qaban irra deebi'anii mirkaneessaniiru. Hoggantoonni biyyoota lamaanii Pariisitti marii taasisaniin, Israa'el babal'ina naannoo qe'ee fi gocha haleellaa Filisxeemota irratti raawwattu akka dhaabdu gaafataniiru. Gochootni kunniin furmaata biyyoota lamaa kan miidhan ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Lockerbie bombing trial postponed days before it was due to start
english: The trial of Abu Agila Mohammad Kheir Al-Marimi, the Libyan man accused of the 1988 Lockerbie bombing, has been delayed once again. The postponement was granted after new evidence emerged just days before the scheduled start in Washington DC, requiring further investigation by the defence. The proceedings are now expected to resume next January, marking another delay in the long-standing case regarding the tragedy that claimed 270 lives.
amharic: የሎከርቢ አውሮፕላን ፍንዳታን በመፈጸም የተጠረጠሩት የሊቢያው ዜጋ አቡ አጊላ መሀመድ ኬር አል-ማሪሚ የፍርድ ሂደት ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ ተራዝሟል። በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ ሊጀመር ቀናት ሲቀሩት አዲስ ማስረጃ በመገኘቱ ምክንያት ጠበቆች ለምርመራ ተጨማሪ ጊዜ እንዲሰጣቸው ጠይቀዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት የችሎቱ መጀመሪያ ወደሚቀጥለው ጥር ወር የተሸጋገረ ሲሆን፣ በ1988 ዓ.ም የ270 ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈውን ይህንን ታሪካዊ ክስተት ፍትህ የማግኘት ሂደት ተጨማሪ መዘግየት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Namichi Libiyaa Abu Agila Mohammad Kheir Al-Marimi jedhamu, kan bara 1988 balaa xiyyaara Lockerbie irratti hirmaate jedhame himatame, dhaddachi isaa yeroo sadaffaaf dheereffameera. Washington DC tti guyyoota muraasa booda dhaddachi kun ni jalqaba jedhamee eegamaa ture iyyuu, ragaan haaraan waan argameef dhaddachi kun gara ji'a Amajjii dhufuutti darbeera. Ragaan haaraan kun akka qoratamuuf gorsitoonni seeraa gaafatan fudhatama waan argateef, balaa namoota 270 galaafate kana irratti dhaddachi gaggeeffamu guyyaan isaa ammas dheerateera.

title: UK drone factories may face attacks from 'unknown sources', says Kremlin adviser
english: A Kremlin adviser has warned that UK drone manufacturing facilities could face attacks from unidentified actors due to Britain's decision to share military technology with Ukraine. This rhetoric follows the UK's move to provide Kyiv with production blueprints for advanced missiles, which Russia claims significantly hampers potential peace efforts. Meanwhile, UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham is planning a trip to the United States to urge President Trump to maintain support for Ukraine's defense needs.
amharic: የክሬምሊን አማካሪ እንደገለጹት ብሪታንያ ለዩክሬን ወታደራዊ ቴክኖሎጂ እና የጦር መሳሪያ ዲዛይኖችን በማቅረቧ ምክንያት በዩኬ የሚገኙ የድሮን ማምረቻ ፋብሪካዎች በማይታወቁ አካላት ጥቃት ሊደርስባቸው ይችላል። ይህ ማስፈራሪያ የመጣው ብሪታንያ ለዩክሬን የረጅም ርቀት ሚሳኤል ማምረቻ እቅዶችን ለማካፈል ከወሰነች በኋላ ሲሆን፣ ሩሲያ ይህ ድርጊት ለሰላም ጥረቶች ትልቅ እንቅፋት እንደሆነ ትከሳለች። በሌላ በኩል የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የዩክሬንን የመከላከል አቅም ለማጠናከር ከአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ጋር ለመነጋገር ወደ አሜሪካ እንደሚጓዙ ታውቋል።
oromo: Gorsaan Kireemliin tokko akka jedhanitti, Biriiteen biyyi Yukreeniif teeknoolojii waraanaa fi pilaanii meeshaalee waraanaa kennuu ishee hordofee, warshaaleen diroonii UK keessa jiran qaama hin beekamneen haleelamuu danda'u. Achiimni kun kan dhufe erga UK pilaanii misaa'eloota fagoo dhaqqaban Yukreenitti kennuu ishee beeksiftee booda yoo ta'u, Raashiyaan gochi kun carraaqqii nagaa miidha jetti. Gama biraatiin, muummeen ministiraa UK Andy Burnham deeggarsa Yukreeniif qaban cimsachuuf fi pirezedaant Traamp waliin mari'achuuf gara Ameerikaatti imaluuf qophaa'aa jiru.

title: Australia’s music charts ban AI-made songs amid backlash over Madonna cover
english: Australia's official music charts have introduced a ban on songs created entirely by artificial intelligence following public criticism regarding an AI-produced cover of a Madonna song. While fully AI-made tracks are now excluded from charts and awards, music that only uses AI as a supporting tool remains eligible. Industry leaders implemented these rules to prioritize human creativity and ensure that technology does not replace original artistic contributions.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ ኦፊሴላዊ የሙዚቃ ገበታዎች በማዶና ዘፈን ላይ በተፈጠረው የኤአይ (AI) አጠቃቀም ውዝግብ ምክንያት ሙሉ በሙሉ በአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ የተሰሩ ዘፈኖችን ከውድድር አግደዋል። አዲሱ ደንብ በኤአይ ሙሉ በሙሉ የተሰሩ ዘፈኖችን ከገበታው የሚያስወግድ ሲሆን፣ ቴክኖሎጂውን እንደ ረዳት መሳሪያ ብቻ የሚጠቀሙ ስራዎች ግን አሁንም ተቀባይነት አላቸው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የሰዎችን ፈጠራ ለመጠበቅ እና የሙዚቃ ኢንዱስትሪው በቴክኖሎጂ ብቻ እንዳይተካ ለማድረግ ነው።
oromo: Gibbiin muuziqaa seera qabeessi Awustiraaliyaa, sirba Maadoonaa tokko irratti teeknooloojii AI fayyadamuudhaan mormiin erga ka'ee booda, sirboota guutummaatti AI'n hojjetaman dhowwuu isaa beeksiseera. Seerri haaraan kun sirboota AI'n guutumaan guutuutti hojjetaman caaltuu (chart) keessaa kan baasu yoo ta'u, teeknooloojii kana akka gargaarsaatti fayyadamanii kan hojjetan garuu ammas fudhatama qabaatu. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame uumamtoota namootaa irratti xiyyeeffachuufi muuziqaan teeknooloojiidhaan akka hin bakka bu'amne ittisuufi.

title: Two US carrier groups in Middle East strain navy resources
english: The United States has moved two aircraft carrier strike groups into the Middle East, representing a major concentration of military power in the region. According to former naval officials, this deployment places a significant strain on navy resources and limits the military's ability to maintain a presence in other parts of the world. This strategy highlights the challenges the U.S. faces in balancing global security priorities with limited naval assets.
amharic: አሜሪካ ሁለት የጦር መርከብ ቡድኖችን ወደ መካከለኛው ምስራቅ መላኳ በአካባቢው ከፍተኛ የሆነ ወታደራዊ አቅም እንዲሰበሰብ አድርጓል። የቀድሞ የባህር ኃይል አመራሮች እንደገለጹት፣ ይህ እርምጃ የባህር ኃይሉን ሀብት በእጅጉ በመጫኑ በሌሎች የዓለም ክፍሎች ተገኝቶ የመንቀሳቀስ አቅሙን ቀንሶታል። ይህም አሜሪካ በዓለም አቀፍ የፀጥታ ጉዳዮች እና ባላት ውስን ወታደራዊ አቅም መካከል ያለውን ሚዛን ለመጠበቅ የምትታገልበትን ፈታኝ ሁኔታ ያሳያል።
oromo: Ameerikaan garee markaboota waraanaa lama gara Baha Giddu-galeessaatti erguun ishee humna waraanaa guddaa naannichatti walitti qabuun ishee agarsiisa. Qondaaltotni kaleessa turan akka ibsanitti, bobbaan kun humna galaanaarratti dhiibbaa guddaa kan uumuufi addunyaa biroo keessatti humna waraanaa qabaachuuf isaan dhibee jedhu. Kunis Ameerikaan eegumsa nageenya addunyaa fi humna waraanaa qabdu gidduutti madaala eeggachuuf qormaata keessa akka jirtu agarsiisa.

title: France and Saudi Arabia plan Dragon Ball Z theme park near Paris
english: France and Saudi Arabia are collaborating on a $7 billion project to build three theme parks in the Paris area. One of these parks will be dedicated to the popular Japanese anime series Dragon Ball Z. This initiative was inspired by the mutual interest in the franchise shared by President Emmanuel Macron and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ እና ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በፓሪስ አቅራቢያ ሶስት መዝናኛ ፓርኮችን ለመገንባት የ7 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የጋራ ፕሮጀክት አቅደዋል። ከእነዚህ ፓርኮች መካከል አንዱ ታዋቂውን የጃፓን አኒሜሽን ተከታታይ ድራጎን ቦል ዚን መሰረት ያደረገ ይሆናል። ይህ እቅድ የተጀመረው የፈረንሳዩ ፕሬዝዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮን እና የሳዑዲው አልጋ ወራሽ መሐመድ ቢን ሳልማን ለዚሁ አኒሜሽን ያላቸውን የጋራ ፍቅር መሰረት በማድረግ ነው።
oromo: Faransaay fi Sa'udii Arabiyaan dirree bashannanaa sadii Paarisitti dhihoo jiru ijaaruuf qophiirra jiru; kunis invastimantii dolaara biliyoona torba ta'u of keessatti qabata. Dirreen bashannanaa kun keessaa tokko fiilmii 'Dragon Ball Z' jedhamu kan Japan irratti kan xiyyeeffatu ta'a. Karoorri kun kan burqe jaalala mootonni lamaan, Pireezidaant Imaanuyel Maakroon fi mootummaa Sa'udii kan ta'an Mohaammad Biin Salmaan, fiilmii kanaaf qaban irraayi.

title: Morning update
english: The Trump administration has officially removed Syria from the U.S. list of state sponsors of terrorism, easing trade and military restrictions. Simultaneously, the U.S. has ramped up economic sanctions against Iran while threatening potential military action amid tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, reports indicate a significant rise in Israeli settler violence in the West Bank, and an oil tanker was disabled by a projectile attack near the coast of Oman.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ሶሪያን ከአሸባሪነት ደጋፊ ሀገራት ዝርዝር ውስጥ በይፋ አውጥቷታል፣ ይህም የንግድ እና ወታደራዊ ገደቦችን ያስወግዳል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ አዳዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን በመጣል ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስፈራርተዋል። በሌላ በኩል በዌስት ባንክ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመሩ የተዘገበ ሲሆን፣ በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ የነዳጅ መርከብም በጥቃት ጉዳት ደርሶበታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Trump biyya Suuriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota gargaaran jedhamuu keessaa haqeera, kunis daangaa daldalaa fi waraanaa irra ture kan kaasuudha. Yeroo walfakkaatuutti, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa diinagdee Iran irratti jabeessuun akkasumas sodaachisa waraanaa dabaluun haala jiru daran hammaachiseetti. Kana malees, naannoo Weest Baankitti haleellaan qotee bulaa Israa'elii dabaluu fi markabni boba'aa tokko garba Omaan keessatti haleellaan miidhamuun gabaafameera.

title: Turkish envoy applauds US removal of Syria from 'terrorism list'
english: The Turkish ambassador to Syria has welcomed the United States' decision to remove Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism. He stated that this move eliminates a major barrier to Syria's global integration and will support regional peace and stability. The envoy expressed hope that this change will lead to improved development and a better future for the Syrian people.
amharic: የቱርክ አምባሳደር አሜሪካ ሶሪያን ከአሸባሪዎች ደጋፊ ሀገራት ዝርዝር ውስጥ ማስወገዷን በበጎነት ተቀብለዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ሶሪያ ከዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ጋር እንዳትዋሃድ የነበረውን ትልቅ እንቅፋት በማስወገድ ለክልሉ ሰላም እና መረጋጋት ትልቅ አስተዋፅኦ እንደሚኖረው ገልጸዋል። አምባሳደሩ ይህ ለውጥ በሶሪያ ህዝብ ዘንድ ተስፋ ሰጪ ለውጥ እና ልማት እንደሚያመጣ ተስፋ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Turkii mootummaan Ameerikaa biyya Sooriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota gargaaran jedhamanii moggaafaman keessaa baasuun ishee dinqisiifataniiru. Tarkaanfin kun Sooriyaan addunyaa waliin akka walitti makamtuuf gufuu guddaa ture kan dhaabuufi nageenya naannichaa mirkaneessuuf shoora olaanaa qaba jedhaniiru. Akkasumas, murteen kun guddina biyyattii fi jireenya uummata Sooriyaa fooyyessuuf bu'aa qabaata jechuun abdii dubbataniiru.

title: Syrian president thanks nation for getting off US state terror list
english: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa has expressed his gratitude to the public after the United States officially removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism. The country had remained on this list since 1979, and its removal is expected to improve the nation's economic outlook. By clearing this major hurdle, Syria is now positioned to attract much-needed international investment for its recovery.
amharic: የሶሪያው ፕሬዝዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራአ አሜሪካ ሶሪያን ከአሸባሪነት ደጋፊ ሀገራት ዝርዝር ውስጥ ካስወጣች በኋላ ለህዝባቸው ምስጋና አቅርበዋል። ሀገሪቱ ከ1979 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ በዚሁ ዝርዝር ውስጥ ትገኝ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ መወገዷም ለውጭ ኢንቨስትመንቶች በሮችን ይከፍታል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ይህ እርምጃ ሀገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚያዊ እገዳዎችን በመጣል ለተፈጠረባት ጫና መፍትሄ እንደምትፈልግ ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Siiriyaa Ahmed al-Sharaa, yeroo amrikaan biyyasaanii tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota gargaaran jedhaman keessaa baastu gammachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Siiriyaa bara 1979 irraa jalqabee tarree kana keessa turte; amma garuu murteen kun biyyattii qabeenya alaa harkisuuf carraa gaarii kenna. Jijjiiramni kun biyyattii rakkoo dinagdee keessaa akka baatuufi guddina biyyaattii akka deeggaree karoorfameera.

title: France, Saudi Arabia agree on $7bn theme park project near Paris
english: France and Saudi Arabia have finalized a $7 billion deal to build a massive theme park complex near Paris. This project, which includes a manga-themed park, is expected to generate over 20,000 jobs and serves as a key initiative to strengthen economic ties between the two nations. Beyond tourism, the partnership includes new cooperation agreements covering defense, artificial intelligence, energy, and transportation.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ እና ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በፓሪስ አቅራቢያ ሰባት ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት ትልቅ የመዝናኛ ፓርክ ለመገንባት ተስማምተዋል። በማንጋ መዝናኛን ጨምሮ የሚገነባው ይህ ፕሮጀክት ከሃያ ሺህ በላይ የስራ ዕድሎችን እንደሚፈጥር እና በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ኢኮኖሚያዊ ግንኙነት እንደሚያጠናክር ይጠበቃል። ከቱሪዝም በተጨማሪ ሁለቱ አገራት በወታደራዊ፣ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI)፣ በኢነርጂ እና በትራንስፖርት ዘርፎች ላይ አዲስ የትብብር ስምምነቶችን ተፈራርመዋል።
oromo: Faransaayiifi Arabaan Saudii paarkii bashannanaa guddaa fi doolaara biiliyoona torba itti ba'u Paaris biratti ijaaruuf walii galaniiru. Piroojektiiwwan kun kanneen akka manga dabalatee, hojiiwwan kuma digdamii ol kan uumuufi hariiroo diinagdee biyyoota lamaanii cimsuuf kan karoorfame dha. Dabalataanis, biyyoonni lameen damee ittisaa, ogummaa namtolchee (AI), anniisaa fi geejjibaa irratti walta'iinsa haaraa gochuuf walii galan.

title: Israeli settler attacks in West Bank surge to 63 percent: Report
english: A new report reveals that violent acts by Israeli settlers in the West Bank increased by 63 percent during the first seven months of this year compared to the same timeframe in 2025. Authorities documented over 4,000 incidents, driven by the expansion of illegal outposts and the increased arming of settlers. These individuals frequently carry out these attacks while receiving protection from Israeli military forces.
amharic: አዲስ ሪፖርት እንደሚያሳየው በምዕራብ ባንክ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ባለፈው ዓመት ተመሳሳይ ወቅት ጋር ሲነጻጸር በዘንድሮው የመጀመሪያ ሰባት ወራት ውስጥ በ63 በመቶ ጨምረዋል። በህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ መስፋፋት እና ሰፋሪዎች በጦር መሳሪያ መታጠቅ ምክንያት ከ4,100 በላይ ጥቃቶች መመዝገባቸው ተገልጿል። እነዚህ ሰፋሪዎች ጥቃቱን በሚፈጽሙበት ወቅት አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ጥበቃ እንደሚደረግላቸው ዘገባው ያመለክታል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraan tokko akka ibsutti, weerara weerartoonni Israa'el naannoo Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti raawwatan waggaa darbee wajjin yoo madaalamu, ji'oota torba dabran keessa dhibbeentaa 63n dabaleera. Babal'achuu manneen jireenyaa seeraan alaa fi hidhachuun weerartootaa walitti bu'iinsa fi haleellaa kuma afur ol ta'eef sababa ta'eera. Weerartoonni kun haleellaa kana raawwatanis humnoota waraana Israa'el irraa eegumsa argachaa akka jiran gabaasichi ni ibsa.

title: NZ religious sect leader jailed over death of Chinese follower
english: A New Zealand religious leader, Kaixiao Liu, has been sentenced to over a decade in prison for the manslaughter and kidnapping of a 70-year-old Chinese follower. The victim, Shulai Wang, died after being restrained for attempting to escape from the sect's compound, where she and others were kept in conditions of servitude. Liu and his family members were caught after disposing of the woman’s body near an Auckland marina, with police linking them to the crime through forensic evidence.
amharic: በኒው ዚላንድ የሚገኝ አንድ የሃይማኖት ቡድን መሪ ካይክሲያኦ ሊዩ፣ የ70 ዓመቷን ቻይናዊ ተከታያቸውን በግድያ እና በጠለፋ ወንጀል ከ10 ዓመት በላይ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። ሹላይ ዋንግ የተባለችው ሴት ከቡድኑ ለመሸሽ ስትሞክር በተደረገባት ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር ህይወቷ አልፏል። ሊዩ እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው የሴትየዋን አስከሬን በባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢ በመጣላቸው በፖሊስ ምርመራ ተደርሶባቸው ለእስራት ተዳርገዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni garee amantii tokko kan biyya Niwuu Ziilaand, Kaixiao Liu, du'a fi butii dubartii umriin ishee 70 ta'e kan biyya Chaayinaa ta'eef hidhaa waggaa kudhanii ol itti murteeffameera. Shulai Wang kan jedhamtu dubartii tana, garee san keessaa bahuuf yeroo yaaltu akka malee qabamtee fi hidhamtee erga turtee booda lubbuun ishee darbe. Liu fi maatiin isaa reeffa dubartittii gamoo Aucklanditti gatuun isaanii qorannoo poolisiin mirkanaa'ee akka adabaman taasiseera.

title: Rare tornado near Carcassonne in France causes damage and injuries
english: A rare tornado recently struck near the city of Carcassonne in southern France, causing significant property damage. The storm damaged approximately one hundred homes and resulted in at least 26 injuries. The twister developed underneath a powerful supercell thunderstorm in the region.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ፈረንሳይ ካርካሶን ከተማ አቅራቢያ በተከሰተ ያልተለመደ የዐውሎ ነፋስ ከባድ ጉዳት ደረሰ። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ ክስተት ወደ አንድ መቶ የሚጠጉ ቤቶችን ያወደመ ሲሆን ቢያንስ 26 ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ዐውሎ ነፋሱ የተፈጠረው በኃይለኛ የነጎድጓድ ደመና ስር መሆኑ ታውቋል።
oromo: Faransaayi kibbaa, magaalaa Kaarkaasooni biratti obomboleettiin dafee hin argamne tokko miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Obomboleettiin kun mana gara dhibba tokko ta'u kan mancaase yoo ta'u, namoota 26 irratti miidhaan qaamaa ga'eera. Obomboleettiin kun kan uumame gartuu duumessa gurguddaa fi hammaataa ta'e jala akka ta'e gabaasameera.

title: Trump unleashes swathe sanctions on Iran 'enablers'
english: The U.S. government has introduced a new round of strict sanctions targeting Iran and those helping the country bypass existing economic restrictions. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that these measures, branded as Operation Economic Outcast, aim to completely isolate Iran's regime unless it changes its behavior. The administration claims it has identified all networks involved in oil smuggling to ensure these new financial penalties are fully enforced.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ኢራንን እና አገሪቱ ያሉባትን የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች እንዲያልፉ የሚረዱ አካላትን ያነጣጠረ አዲስ ጠንከር ያለ ማዕቀብ ጥሏል። የሀገሪቱ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት እንደገለፁት፣ ኦፕሬሽን ኢኮኖሚክ አውትካስት የተሰኘው ይህ እርምጃ ኢራን ባህሪዋን ካልቀየረች በስተቀር ሙሉ ለሙሉ ለማግለል ያለመ ነው። መንግስት የኢራንን የነዳጅ ማዘዋወር አውታረ መረቦች በሙሉ መለየቱን በመግለጽ፣ አዲሱ ማዕቀብ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲተገበር እንደሚሰራ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa Iran fi qaamolee Iran adabbii dinagdee irra jiru akka cabsitu gargaaran irratti adabbii haaraa fi cimaa ergee jira. Ministirri maallaqaa Ameerikaa Scott Bessent akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun kan jalqabame Iran amala ishee yoo hin jijjiirre addunyaa irraa addaan baasuufi. Mootummaan Ameerikaa, networkiiwwan Iran boba'aa seeraan alaa itti gurgurattu hunda adda baasuun, adabbiin kun akka milkaa'u gochuuf akka hojjetu beeksiseera.

title: Israel’s Netanyahu claims Iran tried to kill one of his sons
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has alleged that Iran attempted to assassinate one of his sons, though he provided no specific evidence or details regarding the incident. This claim follows a period of heightened regional tensions triggered by a joint US-Israeli strike that resulted in the deaths of Iran's supreme leader and several family members. Netanyahu shared this information while advocating for increased security measures for political rivals during the lead-up to Israel's October general elections.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ኢራን አንዱን ልጃቸውን ለመግደል ሙከራ አድርጋለች ሲሉ ከሰሱ፣ ነገር ግን ስለ ጉዳዩ ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም። ይህ ክስ የተሰማው የአሜሪካ እና የእስራኤል የጋራ ጥቃት የኢራንን ከፍተኛ መሪ እና የቤተሰባቸውን አባላት ከገደሉ በኋላ በክልሉ ያለው ውጥረት ባየለበት ወቅት ነው። ኔታንያሁ ይህንን የተናገሩት በኦክቶበር ወር ለሚካሄደው ምርጫ ዝግጅት በሚደረግበት ወቅት ለፖለቲካ ተቀናቃኞቻቸው ተጨማሪ ጥበቃ እንደሚያስፈልግ ለማሳሰብ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahu, Iraan ilmaan isaa keessaa tokko ajjeesuuf yaalii gooteetti jedhanii himatan, garuu waa'ee gochichaa ragaa dabalataa ykn bal'ina hin kennine. Himannaan kun kan dhufe, tarkaanfii gamtaa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el hogganaa olaanaa Iraan fi miseensota maatii isaa ajjeese booda waldhabdee naannichaa hammeesse keessaatti. Netaaniyaahu yaada kana kan ibsan, filannoo Israa'el kan gara fuulduraatti gaggeeffamuun dura morkattoota siyaasaaf eegumsi dabalataa akka godhamu gaafachaa turan.

title: Amnesty says India used lethal weapons on ‘Cockroach’ protesters
english: Amnesty International has released a report claiming that the Indian government employed dangerous weapons, such as pellet guns and grenades, to suppress protests led by the Cockroach Janta Party. The human rights organization alleges the use of excessive force against demonstrators. In response, the administration led by Prime Minister Modi has officially rejected these allegations.
amharic: አምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል ባወጣው ዘገባ የህንድ መንግስት በኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ የሚመሩ ሰልፈኞችን ለመበተን የጦር መሳሪያዎችን እና የእጅ ቦምቦችን ጨምሮ ገዳይ የሆኑ መሳሪያዎችን ተጠቅሟል ብሏል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቱ መንግስት ሰልፈኞች ላይ ከልክ ያለፈ ጥቃት ፈጽሟል ሲል ይከሳል። ይሁን እንጂ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሞዲ አስተዳደር በበኩሉ የቀረበውን ክስ ውድቅ አድርጓል።
oromo: Amnesty International gabaasa baaseen, mootummaan Indiyaa hiriiroota 'Cockroach Janta Party'tiin gaggeeffaman ukkaamsuuf meeshaalee du'a fidan, kanneen akka qawwee dhuka'uu fi boombiiwwan itti fayyadameera jedhe. Dhaabbatichi mirga namoomaa mootummaan kun hiriiroota irratti humna guddaa fayyadameera jechuun himata. Mootummaan ministira muummee Modi garuu himata kana guutummaatti haaleera.

title: US senators demand hearing over toll on troops amid war on Iran
english: A group of twelve US senators is requesting a congressional hearing to address the harsh conditions faced by troops deployed during the conflict with Iran. The lawmakers argue that poor strategic planning has led to severe supply shortages and declining morale among service members on naval ships and bases. They are calling on defense leaders to explain these systemic failures and provide a clear strategy to improve soldier welfare and resolve the ongoing situation.
amharic: አስራ ሁለት የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ሴናተሮች ከኢራን ጋር ባለው ግጭት ምክንያት በወታደሮቹ ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ችግር ለመመርመር የኮንግረስ ችሎት እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል። የሕግ አውጪዎቹ ደካማ ወታደራዊ ዕቅድ በጦር መርከቦች እና በጦር ሰፈሮች ውስጥ የምግብ እና የመድኃኒት አቅርቦት እጥረትን እንዳስከተለ ይገልጻሉ። የጦር መሪዎች ለዚህ ችግር ተጠያቂ እንዲሆኑ እና ወታደሮችን ለመታደግ ግልጽ የሆነ መፍትሄ እንዲያቀርቡም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Senataronni Amerikaa kudha lama walitti buiinsa Iran waliin jiruun wal qabatee loltoonni miidhaa irra gahuu isaa hordofee qorannoo kuta-seeraa akka godhamu gaafatan. Hojjettooni mootummaa kun karoorri waraanaa laafaan dhiyeessii nyaataa fi qorichaa dooniiwwan waraanaa fi buufataalee keessatti akka hir’atu taasiseera jedhu. Itti gaafatamtoonni waraanaa hanqina kanaaf ibsa akka kennanii fi jireenya loltootaa fooyyessuuf mala ifa ta’e akka qopheessan gaafataniiru.

title: French tourist dies in Death Valley after car gets stuck in mud
english: A 68-year-old French tourist died in California's Death Valley after his vehicle became trapped in mud during extreme heat. He and his companion attempted to walk for help, but the victim succumbed to temperatures exceeding 46 degrees Celsius. Officials noted that the harsh environment remains dangerous even for experienced travelers, especially during current record-breaking heatwaves.
amharic: የ68 ዓመት የፈረንሳይ ቱሪስት በካሊፎርኒያ ደዝ ቫሊ መኪናቸው በጭቃ በመጣበቁ ምክንያት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እሳቸው እና አብረዋቸው የነበሩት ሰው ለእርዳታ በእግር ሲጓዙ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ከ46 ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ በላይ በሆነው ከፍተኛ ሙቀት የተነሳ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ እንደገለጹት በአሁኑ ወቅት ያለው ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን ለተጓዦች እጅግ አደገኛ እንደሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Turistiin lammii Faransaay umriin isaanii 68 ta'e tokko, konkolaataan isaanii biyyee keessatti erga makamee booda gammoojjii Deeth Vaalii keessatti lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Isaanifi hiriyaan isaanii gargaarsa argachuuf miilaan yoo deemaniyyuu, ho'i cimaan digrii 46 ol ta'e isaan miidhee jira. Bulchiinsi bakka sanas, ho'i cimaan kun yeroo ammaa bakkeewwan hedduutti mudachaa jiru namoota maraaf balaa guddaa akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Muslims celebrate Prophet Muhammad’s birthday
english: Muslim communities in nations including Iraq, Libya, and Morocco recently observed Mawlid al-Nabi to honor the birth of Prophet Muhammad. The occasion was marked by various religious activities, including organized processions and communal prayers. These gatherings serve as a traditional way for followers to commemorate the life and teachings of the Prophet.
amharic: እንደ ኢራቅ፣ ሊቢያ እና ሞሮኮ ባሉ ሀገራት የሚገኙ ሙስሊሞች የነቢዩ መሐመድን ልደት ለማክበር መውሊድ አል-ነቢን አክብረዋል። በዓሉ በተለያዩ ሃይማኖታዊ ስነ-ስርዓቶች፣ በህዝባዊ ሰልፎች እና በጋራ ጸሎቶች ታጅቦ ተከብሯል። እነዚህ ዝግጅቶች አማኞች የነቢዩን ህይወት እና አስተምህሮ ለማስታወስ የሚጠቀሙባቸው ባህላዊ መንገዶች ናቸው።
oromo: Muslimoonni biyyoota akka Iraaq, Liibiyaa fi Morookoo keessa jiraatan dhaloota Ergamaa Muhammad, Mawliidaan kabajatan. Kabajni kun sagantaalee amantii garaagaraa, hiriiraa fi kadhannaa waloo kan of keessatti qabate ture. Walga’iiwwan kun hordoftoonni jireenyaa fi barsiisa Ergamaa sanaa yaadachuuf kan itti fayyadaman ta’uun beekameera.

title: Man killed in world’s largest annual bullfighting event in Mexico
english: A 29-year-old man lost his life and nine others were hurt during the annual Huamantlada bullfighting festival in Mexico. The event involved releasing 21 bulls onto the streets of Tlaxcala for the public to face. This celebration is recognized as the world's largest open-road bullfighting gathering.
amharic: በሜክሲኮ በሚካሄደው ዓመታዊ የሁአማንትላዳ የበሬ ማታገያ በዓል ላይ የ29 ዓመት ወጣት ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ ሌሎች ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በቲላክሳላ ከተማ ጎዳናዎች ላይ 21 በሬዎች ተለቀው በነበረበት ወቅት ነው ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተከሰተው። ይህ በዓል በዓለም ትልቁ የጎዳና ላይ የበሬ ማታገያ ኩነት ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Meksiikootti ayyaana loon waliin falmiisii waggaa waggaan geggeeffamu kan Huamantlada jedhamu irratti, dargaggeessi umuriin isaa 29 du'eera; namoonni sagal ammoo miidhaniiru. Ayyaanichi magaalaa Tlaaksalaa keessatti loon 21 daandiiwwan irratti gadi dhiisuun kan geggeeffame dha. Ayyaanichi addunyaa irratti walgahii loon walitti fiduun daandii irratti geggeeffamu keessaa isa guddaa dha.

title: Commodity vessel transits through Hormuz Strait drop to three-month low
english: Shipping data indicates that only one commodity vessel passed through the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, marking the lowest activity level in three months. While this figure represents a significant drop since early May, it remains preliminary because some ships may be navigating the area with their tracking devices turned off. As a result, the total count may increase once more comprehensive data becomes available.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የመርከብ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት ሰኞ ዕለት አንድ የሸቀጥ መርከብ ብቻ በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ማለፉን ሲሆን ይህም ባለፉት ሶስት ወራት ውስጥ እጅግ ዝቅተኛው ቁጥር ነው። ይህ አሃዝ ከግንቦት ወር ወዲህ የታየ ዝቅተኛ እንቅስቃሴ ቢሆንም፣ አንዳንድ መርከቦች መከታተያዎቻቸውን በማጥፋታቸው ምክንያት ቁጥሩ ሊለወጥ እንደሚችል ተጠቁሟል። ስለዚህ ተጨማሪ መረጃዎች ሲገኙ ትክክለኛው የዕለቱ የትራፊክ እንቅስቃሴ ግልጽ ሊሆን ይችላል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon markabootaa akka agarsiisutti, Wiixata darbe markabni meeshaalee fe'u tokko qofatu boolla Hormuz keessa darbe; kunis sadarkaa gadi aanaa ji'a sadii darbe keessatti mul'ateedha. Lakkoofsi kun ji'a Caamsaa as sadarkaa baay'ee gadi aanaa ta'us, markaboonni tokko tokko meeshaa ittiin of hordofan waan cufataniif lakkoofsi kun jijjiiramuu danda'a. Kanaafuu, odeeffannoon guutuun erga argamee booda lakkoofsi dhugaa ifa ta'uu danda'a.

title: US senator criticises economic 'D-Day' against Iran, says 'Trump is losing'
english: US Senator Chris Murphy has condemned the Trump administration's new economic sanctions against Iran, labeling them an ineffective strategy to mask a failing military campaign. Murphy argued that the US has largely lost the conflict, citing Iran’s control over key shipping routes and the exhaustion of American military resources. He maintains that these new measures are merely a desperate attempt to create an illusion of progress while the American public bears the financial burden of the failed policy.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ሴናተር ክሪስ መርፊ በኢራን ላይ የተጣለውን አዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ በመተቸት፣ ይህ እርምጃ በወታደራዊ ዘመቻው የተሸነፈውን የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ውድቀት ለመሸፈን የሚደረግ ሙከራ ነው ብለዋል። ሴናተሩ ኢራን ወሳኝ የሆኑ የባህር መስመሮችን መቆጣጠሯን እና የአሜሪካ የጦር መሣሪያ አቅርቦት መሟጠጡን በመጥቀስ፣ ጦርነቱ በተግባር ኢራንን ተጠቃሚ እንዳደረገ ተናግረዋል። ይህ የኢኮኖሚ ግፊትም የአሜሪካን ሕዝብ ዋጋ እያስከፈለ ያለ ከንቱ ድርጊት መሆኑንም አክለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Senator Ameerikaa Chris Murphy adabbii diinagdee haaraa Iran irratti bu'e akka mala dadhabinaa fi injifannoo dhabuu mootummaan Trump akka dhoksuuf qofa fayyadamuun qeeqe. Murphy, Iran daandiiwwan galaanaatti fayyadamuu fi meeshaaleen waraana Ameerikaas hir'achuu isaanii eeruun, waraanichi guutummaatti Iranif milkaa'ina fiduu isaa ibseera. Adabbiin kunis uummata Ameerikaa gatii guddaa kaffalchiisaa akka jiru fi imaammata bu'a qabeessa hin taane ta'uu isaa himeera.

title: Pakistani army chief discussed 'ending deadlock' in US-Iran talks during visit to Tehran
english: Pakistan's army chief, Asim Munir, visited Tehran to hold high-level meetings with senior Iranian officials regarding regional stability. The discussions focused on finding ways to break the ongoing stalemate in diplomatic negotiations between the United States and Iran. This visit highlights Pakistan's active role in trying to reduce regional tensions and promote long-term peace.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የጦር ኃይሎች አዛዥ አሲም ሙኒር በኢራን ጉብኝት በማድረግ ከከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ጋር በክልሉ መረጋጋት ዙሪያ ተወያይተዋል። የውይይቱ ዋና ትኩረት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል የቆመውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እንደገና ለማስቀጠል በሚቻልበት መንገድ ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር። ይህ ጉብኝት ፓኪስታን በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ እና ዘላቂ ሰላምን ለማምጣት እየጣረች መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Paakistaan Asim Muneer, nageenya naannichaa irratti mari’achuuf gara Tehraan imaluun aangeyyota olaanoo Iraan waliin wal arganiiru. Mariin kun mootummoota Amerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti haasawaa dippiloomaasii dhaabbatee ture furuufi waliigaltee irra ga’uuf xiyyeeffate. Imalli kun Paakistaan waldhabiinsa naannichaa hir’isuufi nageenya waaraa fiduuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtu kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Brutal gang attack on strategic Haiti hillside leaves at least 30 dead
english: At least 30 individuals were killed during a violent gang assault in the strategic hillside community of Kenscoff, Haiti. This location is significant because it overlooks important transport routes leading into the capital city, Port-au-Prince. Armed groups have been repeatedly targeting the area to expand their control over the capital region.
amharic: በሄይቲ ኬንስኮፍ በተባለች ስልታዊ በሆነች አካባቢ በታጠቁ ቡድኖች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 30 ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተገልጿል። ይህ ስፍራ ወደ ዋና ከተማዋ ፖርቶፕሪንስ የሚያመሩ ዋና ዋና መንገዶችን የሚቆጣጠር በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ትኩረት አለው። የታጠቁ ቡድኖች በዋና ከተማዋ ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ ለማጠናከር ሲሉ አካባቢውን በተደጋጋሚ እያጠቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Haiti keessatti magaalaa Kenskoof jedhamtu kan bakka tarsiimawaa ta'e irra jirtutti garee hidhata qabuun haleellaa raawwatameen namoonni 30 ol du'aniiru. Magaalaan kun karaalee gurguddoo gara magaalaa guddoo Poorto-Priinsitti geessan waan to'attuuf bakka barbaachisaa dha. Gareewwan hidhattootaa kunneen to'annoo isaanii magaalaa guddootti babal'isuuf jecha yeroo dheeraaf naannicha haleelaa jiru.

title: US plans to revoke business, tourism visas of 200,000 asylum seekers
english: The U.S. government intends to cancel the business and tourism visas of approximately 200,000 individuals who have applied for asylum after entering the country. This move, which would be the largest mass visa revocation in American history, targets those officials believe are using temporary visitor visas to bypass immigration rules. While this action will change the immigration status of these individuals as their asylum claims are processed, it will not lead to immediate deportation.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ወደ ሀገሪቱ በቱሪስት እና በንግድ ቪዛ ገብተው ጥገኝነት የጠየቁ ወደ 200,000 የሚጠጉ ግለሰቦችን ቪዛ ለመሰረዝ አቅዷል። ይህ በአሜሪካ ታሪክ ትልቁ የቪዛ ስረዛ እርምጃ ሊሆን እንደሚችል የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ አላማውም ጊዜያዊ ቪዛን ለቋሚ መኖሪያነት እንደ መጠቀሚያ የሚጠቀሙ ሰዎችን ለመቆጣጠር ነው። ምንም እንኳን ይህ እርምጃ የተጎጂዎችን የኢሚግሬሽን ሁኔታ የሚቀይር ቢሆንም፣ ወዲያውኑ ከሀገር ማስወጣትን ግን አያካትትም።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa namoota biyyattii keessa jiran kanneen viizaa tuurizimii fi daldalaan seenanii booda koolu-galtummaa gaafatan 200,000 ta'an irraa viizaa isaanii haquuf karoorfateera. Tarkaanfichi seenaa Ameerikaa keessatti kan hanga kanaa yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaa namoota viizaa yeroo gabaabaa fayyadamanii biyyattii keessa jiraachuuf yaalan to'achuu dha. Haala kanaan namoonni kunneen haala isaanii keessa jiran jijjiiramus, tarkaanfichi battalatti biyyaa baasuuf kan murteesse miti.

title: DRC’s constitutional battle: The fight over the 2028 vote
english: President Felix Tshisekedi’s push for institutional reform in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has sparked intense debate regarding potential changes to presidential term limits ahead of the 2028 election. While the government claims these reforms are necessary for stability, critics fear they could be used to bypass constitutional restrictions on a third term. This political tension is intensifying as the country continues to struggle with the M23 rebellion in its eastern provinces.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎው ፕሬዚዳንት ፌሊክስ ሺሰኬዲ የሚያራምዱት ተቋማዊ ለውጥ፣ ከ2028 ምርጫ በፊት የፕሬዚዳንታዊ የስልጣን ዘመን ገደብን ለማሻሻል ያለመ ነው የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል። መንግስት ለውጦቹ ለሀገር ሰላም አስፈላጊ ናቸው ቢልም፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን ይህ አካሄድ ፕሬዚዳንቱ ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ እንዲወዳደሩ መንገድ የሚከፍት ነው በማለት ይከራከራሉ። ይህ የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ አገሪቱ በምስራቃዊ ክፍሏ ከሚገኘው ኤም-23 አማፂ ቡድን ጋር በከባድ ጦርነት ውስጥ ባለችበት ወቅት መፈጠሩ ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አወሳስቦታል።
oromo: Pireezidaantichi DR Congo Feliks Tshisekeedi jijjiirama caasaa mootummaa fiduuf yaalii taasisan, filannoo bara 2028 dura daangaa waqtii tajaajilaa pireezidaantummaa jijjiiruuf yaadamee mitii jechuun shakkii guddaa uumeera. Mootummaan jijjiiramichi tasgabbii biyyaaf barbaachisaa dha jedhee kan falmu yoo ta'u, mormitoonni garuu adeemsichi pireezidaantichi yeroota lama ol aangoo irra akka turan gargaaruu danda'a jedhanii sodaatu. Wal dhabdeen kun biyyattiin gama bahaatti waraana garee M-23 waliin wal qabatee rakkoo keessa jirtu kanatti caalaatti xaxamaa ta'ee jira.

title: Search continues in Tunisia as migrant boat sinking sparks protests
english: A migrant boat carrying 15 people sank off the coast of Tunisia, resulting in at least 12 confirmed deaths and leaving two individuals missing. The tragedy triggered violent protests in the city of Ben Guerdane, where residents burned tires and blocked roads to demand better economic opportunities. Local officials and citizens argue that the lack of jobs and systemic neglect are forcing young people to risk their lives on dangerous sea journeys to Europe.
amharic: ቱኒዚያ ውስጥ 15 ስደተኞችን ጭኖ ሲጓዝ የነበረ ጀልባ በመስጠሙ ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች መሞታቸው እና ሁለት ሰዎች መጥፋታቸው ተረጋግጧል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በቤን ጉርዳኔ ከተማ ተቃውሞዎችን ያስነሳ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎች የተሻለ የኢኮኖሚ እድል በመጠየቅ መንገዶችን ዘግተው ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እና ባለስልጣናት እንደሚሉት፣ የስራ እድል ማጣት እና የረጅም ጊዜ ቸልተኝነት ወጣቶችን ለእንደዚህ አይነት አደገኛ የባህር ጉዞዎች እየዳረገ ነው።
oromo: Tuniziyaatti dooniin godaantota 15 fe'ee deemaa ture garba keessatti gadi lixuun, namoonni 12 du'uu fi lama immoo akka dhabaman mirkanaa'eera. Balaan kun magaala Ben Guerdane keessatti mormii cimaa kan kaase yoo ta'u, jiraattonni haala jireenyaa fi carraa hojii fooyyee gaafachuudhaan daandiiwwan cufuun mormiisaanii ibsataniiru. Namoonni naannichaa akka jedhanitti, carraa hojii dhabuu fi tuffatamuun ijoollee fi dargaggoota biyyattii jireenya fooyyee barbaacha gara Awurooppaa deemuuf gara qarqara du'aatti isaan geessaa jira.

title: UN calls for protection of civilians in Gaza amid Israeli attacks
english: The United Nations has urged for the immediate protection of civilians and aid facilities in Gaza following an Israeli airstrike that damaged three humanitarian warehouses. UN officials emphasized that civilian infrastructure must remain off-limits to military attacks. Furthermore, they called for increased humanitarian aid access to address the growing risk of child malnutrition caused by insufficient supply deliveries.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ሶስት የመጋዘን ህንጻዎቹ መጎዳታቸውን ተከትሎ በጋዛ የሚገኙ ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን እና የሰብአዊ መርጃ ተቋማትን እንዲጠብቁ አሳስቧል። ድርጅቱ ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን እና መሠረተ ልማቶችን ኢላማ ማድረግ እንደማይገባ አስታውቋል። በተጨማሪም በቂ የምግብ አቅርቦት ባለመኖሩ በህጻናት ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጥረት ለመከላከል የዕርዳታ አቅርቦት እንዲጨምር ጠይቋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii haleellaa qilleensaatiin godaambaan isaanii sadii erga miidhamee booda, Gaza keessatti namoota nagaa fi dhaabbilee gargaarsaa eeguun akka barbaachisu ibseera. Qondaalonni dhaabbatichaa bu'uuraalee misoomaa namoota nagaaf tajaajilan irratti haleellaa raawwachuun gonkumaa akka hin taane hubachiisaniiru. Dabalataanis, hir'ina gargaarsa nyaataa irraa kan ka'e daa'imman irratti rakkoo miidhamaa jiru hambisuuf, gargaarsi hatattamaan akka dabalu gaafataniiru.

title: Ahmad al-Sharaa hails Syria's removal from US 'terrorism list'
english: Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa recently celebrated the United States' decision to remove his country from its list of state sponsors of terrorism. He praised this development as a significant step that will allow Syria to focus on national reconstruction and economic growth. Additionally, he expressed his gratitude toward Donald Trump, describing the policy change as a historic achievement for the Syrian people.
amharic: የሶሪያው ፕሬዚዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ አሜሪካ አገራቸውን ከአሸባሪነት ደጋፊዎች ዝርዝር ውስጥ መሰረዟን አድንቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ሶሪያ ወደ ልማት እና ግንባታ ስራዎች እንድትገባ ትልቅ እድል እንደሚፈጥር ገልጸዋል። እንዲሁም ለዚህ ታሪካዊ እርምጃ ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕን አመስግነዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Suuriyaa Ahmad al-Sharaa mootummaan Ameerikaa biyya isaanii tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota gargaaran keessaa baasuu ishee gammachuun simataniiru. Murtoon kun Suuriyaan gama diinagdee fi ijaarsa biyyaatti akka cimsattuuf carraa gaarii akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Kana malees, murtoo seena qabeessa kanaaf Pireezidaant Doonaald Traamp galateeffataniiru.

title: Trump removes Syria from 'terrorism list'
english: The Trump administration has officially removed Syria from the U.S. list of state sponsors of terrorism, a significant change that permits military aid and ends export restrictions. Additionally, the U.S. government revoked the terrorist designation for the militant group Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated these shifts are intended to help the Syrian people, despite recent military tensions involving Israel.

Officials argue that this trend is driven by official government policies and the ongoing expansion of illegal settlements.

title: UN offers to facilitate fertiliser transit through Strait of Hormuz
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has proposed acting as a neutral mediator to ensure the safe movement of fertilizer shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. This initiative aims to decrease regional tensions and stabilize supply chains affected by current conflicts. The plan requires the consent of all involved parties and would be managed with the assistance of Oman to verify cargo vessels.

title: US removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism
english: The United States has officially removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism after nearly five decades, citing the government's efforts to move away from terrorist activities. This decision allows for private sector investment and aims to integrate the nation into the global economy while moving it away from the influence of Russia and China. Led by President Ahmed al-Sharaa, whose formerly militant group has also been removed from terror lists, Syria plans to use this opportunity to stabilize its economy despite ongoing regional security concerns.

title: Moment tornado tears through southern France
english: A powerful tornado recently struck villages in southern France, causing significant damage to residential buildings. The disaster also left thousands of homes without power and resulted in several road closures across the affected areas.

title: US Supreme Court sides with Trump administration on mail voting
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has issued a ruling that allows the Trump administration to move forward with executive orders aimed at restricting mail-in voting. Opponents argue that these changes threaten to disrupt election processes and exceed the President's constitutional authority.

title: US removes Syria from ‘state sponsor of terrorism’ list
english: The United States has officially removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism, following a decision originally announced in July. This move also includes declassifying Hayat Tahrir al-Sham, once led by current President Ahmed al-Sharaa, as a terrorist organization. These changes aim to support economic recovery and international investment in Syria as the country continues its transition under the new leadership.

oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyya Suriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota deeggaran jedhamu irraa haquusaa beeksiseera. Murtiin kun garee ‘Hayat Tahrir al-Sham’ jedhamu kan yeroo durii pirezidaantii ammaatti, Ahmed al-Sharaa, hogganamaa ture illee tarree shororkeessitoota keessaa akka bahu taasiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii keessatti tasgabbii dinagdee uumuufi invastimantii alaa harkisuuf gargaara jedhamee amanama.

title: Jeffries-Kushner meeting sparks speculation amid contentious US midterms
english: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries recently held a private meeting with Jared Kushner to explore potential bipartisan cooperation ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. The discussion reportedly covered critical topics like immigration, housing, and inflation, though specific details remain undisclosed. This move suggests the Trump administration may be preparing for a shift in power should Democrats successfully regain control of the House.
amharic: የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አናሳ መሪ ሀኪም ጄፍሪስ ከመጪው የመሃል ዘመን ምርጫ በፊት ሊኖር ስለሚችል የሁለትዮሽ ትብብር ለመወያየት ከጃሬድ ኩሽነር ጋር በግል ተገናኝተዋል። ውይይቱ እንደ ስደት፣ መኖሪያ ቤት እና የኑሮ ውድነት ያሉ አበይት ጉዳዮችን ያካተተ ቢሆንም ዝርዝር መረጃው ይፋ አልወጣም። ይህ ስብሰባ ዴሞክራቶች የምክር ቤቱን የበላይነት መልሰው የሚያገኙ ከሆነ አስተዳደሩ ሊኖር ስለሚችለው የሥልጣን ለውጥ ቅድመ ዝግጅት እያደረገ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii mormituu Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummataa Hakeem Jeffries, filannoo gidduu waggaa dhufuun dura walitti dhufeenya lamaan qabatee hojjechuuf, Jared Kushner waliin marii dhimma dhuunfaa ta'e taasisaniiru. Marichi dhimmoota ijoo kanneen akka godaantotaa, manaa fi gatii jireenyaa irratti xiyyeeffateera, garuu bal'inni isaa ifa hin taane. Walgahichi kun, yoo paartiin Dimookraatawaa to'annoo Mana Maree deebisanii argatan mootummaan Trump jijjiirama dhufuuf qophii ta'uu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: US public support for Iran war falls as Trump approval at record low: Poll
english: A recent poll indicates that public backing for the ongoing U.S. conflict with Iran has hit a new low, influenced by rising fuel costs and concerns about a prolonged war. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump's approval rating has dropped to his record minimum as fewer Republicans continue to support the military campaign. Despite the administration's plan to escalate economic sanctions against Tehran, a vast majority of Americans now anticipate that the fighting will continue for an extended period.
amharic: አዲስ የተደረገ የሕዝብ አስተያየት ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ላለው ጦርነት የአሜሪካውያን ድጋፍ በነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ እና በጦርነቱ መዘግየት ምክንያት ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን ያሳያል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ተወዳጅነት ወደ ታሪካዊ ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ የወረደ ሲሆን፣ የሪፐብሊካን ደጋፊዎችም ለወታደራዊ ዘመቻው ያላቸው ድጋፍ እየቀነሰ መጥቷል። መንግሥት በኢራን ላይ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን ለማጠናከር ቢዘጋጅም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ አሜሪካውያን ግጭቱ ለረጅም ጊዜ እንደሚቀጥል ስጋት አላቸው።
oromo: Qorannoon haaraan tokko akka ibsutti, deeggarsi ummata Ameerikaa waraana Iraan irratti geggeeffamuuf qaban gatii boba’aa dabee fi waraanni dheerachuu isaa sodachuu irraan kan ka’e sadarkaa gadi aanaatti gadi bu’eera. Yeroo wal fakkaatu kanatti, fudhatamni Preezidaant Doonald Tiraamp sadarkaa seenaa keessatti gadi aanaa ta’etti kan kufe yoo ta’u, deggartoonni Paartii Ripaabilikaanii waraana kanaaf qabanis hir’ateera. Mootummaan biyyattii tarkaanfii dinagdee Iraan irratti fudhatamu cimsuuf karoorfate iyyuu, lammiileen Ameerikaa hedduun walitti bu’iinsi kun yeroo dheeraaf kan itti fufu ta’uu isaa sodaatu.

title: Iconic Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour passes away at age 79
english: Renowned Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour has passed away at the age of 79. He was widely celebrated for creating powerful imagery that symbolized Palestinian identity, cultural heritage, and the enduring struggle against displacement. His artistic legacy remains a significant pillar in documenting the history and resilience of his people.
amharic: ታዋቂው ፍልስጤማዊ ሰዓሊ ስሊማን ማንሱር በ79 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። አርቲስቱ የፍልስጤምን ማንነት፣ ባህል እና ለነፃነት የሚያደርጉትን ተጋድሎ በሚያሳዩ ስራዎቹ ይታወቃሉ። የእሳቸው የጥበብ ስራዎች የህዝባቸውን ታሪክ እና ጥንካሬ በመመዝገብ ረገድ ትልቅ ሚና ነበራቸው።
oromo: Artistii beekamaa Falastiin Sliman Mansuur umurii waggaa 79tti du'aan boqoteera. Inni hojiiwwan aartii uummata Falastiin, aadaa fi qabsoo bilisummaa isaanii ibsan uumuun beekama ture. Hojiiwwan isaa seenaa fi jabinna uummata isaa calaqqisiisuun kan yaadatamuu dha.

title: Displaced Palestinians in Gaza face intensifying Israeli strikes
english: Israeli military forces have increased their attacks on Gaza, including a recent strike on a tent area for displaced families in Deir al-Balah. This violence has resulted in at least one death at the site and contributes to a rising toll of over 1,300 Palestinian deaths since the end of the October ceasefire. Displaced civilians continue to struggle with unsafe conditions as military operations intensify across the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በጋዛ የሚያደርሱትን ጥቃት አጠናክረው የቀጠሉ ሲሆን፣ በቅርቡ በዴር አል-ባላህ ተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ ድንኳኖች ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ተገድሏል። ከጥቅምት ወር የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ ብቻ ከ1,300 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን በአካባቢው ተገድለዋል። ተፈናቃዮች በየጊዜው እየጨመረ በመጣው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ስጋትና አስከፊ የኑሮ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el gaaza keessatti haleellaa cimaa gaggeessaa jiru; dhiheenya kana qubata namoota buqqa'anii Deer al-Balaah keessa jiraatan irratti haleellaa raawwataniin namni tokko du'eera. Waraanni kun erga sochiin dhaabbii waraanaa ji'a Onkololeessaa dhaabbatee as, lubbuu namoota Palastin 1,300 ol galaafateera. Namoonni buqqa'an haleellaa waraanaa dabalaa jiru kanaan rakkoo hamaa fi sodaa jireenyaa keessa jiraatu.

title: Trump removes Syria from 'terrorism list'
english: The Trump administration has officially removed Syria from the U.S. State Sponsor of Terrorism list, ending decades of sanctions that had been in place since 1979. Secretary of State Marco Rubio also removed the terrorist designation from Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham, which is led by Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa. This decision aims to improve bilateral relations and allows for the provision of military aid, marking a major shift in U.S. foreign policy toward the Middle East.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ሶሪያን ከአሜሪካ የሽብርተኝነት ድጋፍ ሰጪ አገራት ዝርዝር ውስጥ በይፋ ሰርዟል፤ ይህም ከ1979 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ሲተገበር የነበረውን ማዕቀብ የሚያበቃ ነው። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ የሶሪያው ፕሬዚዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ በሚመሩት ሃያት ታህሪር አል-ሻም ቡድን ላይ የነበረውን የሽብርተኝነት መለያም አንስተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማሻሻል እና ወታደራዊ እርዳታ ለመፍቀድ ያለመ ሲሆን፣ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ፖሊሲ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥን ያመላክታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Traamp biyya Suuriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota deeggaran jedhamanii U.S.A biratti beekamanii keessaa haqeera. Kana waliin walqabatee, ministirri dhimma alaa Maarko Ruubiyoos gareen Hay'at Tahriir al-Shaam jedhamu kan pireezidaantii Suuriyaa Ahimad al-Shaara'aan hogganamu, tarree shororkeessitootaa keessaa akka bahu taasiseera. Murtiin kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fooyyessuufi gargaarsa waraanaa kennuuf karaa kan banu yoo tahu, siyaasa alaa U.S.A keessatti jijjiirama guddaa agarsiisa.

title: Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour dies aged 79
english: Renowned Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour has passed away at the age of 79. Over his five-decade career, he became a central figure in defining Palestinian cultural identity through his iconic paintings that featured symbols like olive trees and traditional embroidery. Beyond his artwork, he made significant contributions to the arts community by co-founding institutions dedicated to preserving Palestinian creativity and connecting artists globally.
amharic: ታዋቂው ፍልስጤማዊ ሰዓሊ ስሊማን ማንሱር በ79 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። ለአምስት አሥርት ዓመታት በዘለቀው የሥራ ዘመናቸው፣ የወይራ ዛፎችን እና ባህላዊ ጥልፍን የመሳሰሉ ምልክቶችን በመጠቀም የፍልስጤምን ማንነት በመግለጽ ትልቅ ሚና ተጫውተዋል። ከሥነ ጥበብ ሥራዎቻቸው በተጨማሪ የፍልስጤምን ጥበብ ለመጠበቅ እና አርቲስቶችን ለማገናኘት የሚያግዙ ተቋማትን በመመስረት ለኪነ ጥበብ ማህበረሰቡ ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ አበርክተዋል።
oromo: Artistii beekamaa Filisxeem Sliman Mansuur umuriisaa waggaa 79tti du'aan boqotee jira. Hojii isaa waggoota shantama darban keessatti, muka ejersaa fi dhawaa aadaa fayyadamuun eenyummaa Filisxeem ibsuuf gumaacha guddaa godhee ture. Hojii isaa cinaatti, dhaabbilee aartii Filisxeem eeguu fi artistoota walitti fiduu irratti hojjetan hundeessee jira.

title: What’s behind domestic political pressure on Ukraine’s president?
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is facing increased internal political tension as the war with Russia continues. While international leaders have visited to support the country's independence, Zelenskyy has dismissed suggestions to hold national elections during the ongoing conflict. His administration is also dealing with heightened scrutiny following recent corruption scandals involving high-ranking officials.
amharic: ከሩሲያ ጋር ያለው ጦርነት በቀጠለበት በዚህ ወቅት የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በአገር ውስጥ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ጫና ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ዓለም አቀፍ መሪዎች የዩክሬንን ነጻነት ለመደገፍ ቢጎበኙም፣ ፕሬዝዳንቱ ግን በጦርነቱ መሀል ምርጫ ለማካሄድ የሚቀርቡ ጥያቄዎችን ውድቅ አድርገዋል። በተጨማሪም መንግሥታቸው ከፍተኛ የመንግሥት ባለሥልጣናት የተሳተፉበት የሙስና ምርመራዎችን ተከትሎ የሚሰነዘርበትን ትችት መጋፈጥ ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Prezidaantiin Yukireen Volodimir Zeleniski waraanni Rashiyaa wajjin itti fufaa jiruun wal qabatee dhiibbaa siyaasaa biyya keessaa mudachaa jiru. Hogganoonni idil-addunyaa biyyattii daawwatanis, Zeleniskiin yeroo waraanaatti filannoo gaggeessuuf dhiibbaa godhamu fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Kana malees, mootummaan isaa qorannoo malaammaltummaa hoggantoota olaanoo irratti xiyyeeffatu keessa darbaa jira.

title: Video: Iran reacts to US ‘economic D-Day’ sanctions
english: The United States has launched a new campaign of severe economic sanctions aimed at cutting off all financial support for Iran. In response, Iranian Economy Minister Ali Madani-Zadeh rejected the pressure, asserting that these efforts will not succeed. The move marks a significant escalation in ongoing tensions between the two nations.

Ministirri Diinagdee Iraan Ali Madani-Zadeh gamasaaniin, yaalii Ameerikaa kana kan morman yoo ta’u, adeemsi kun akka kanaan duraa milkaa’ina hin qabu jedhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru kan dhiphise ta’uun ibsameera.

title: Ceasefire monitoring mission arrives in Democratic Republic of Congo
english: A monitoring team has arrived in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo to oversee a ceasefire between government forces and M23 rebels. Despite peace agreements mediated by Qatar, ongoing violence has persisted in the mineral-rich South Kivu region. This new mission includes representatives from both conflict parties and regional observers to verify adherence to the truce and investigate reports of violations.

oromo: Mootummaa Dimokiraatawaa Rippaabilika Kongoo keessatti waraana mootummaa fi finxaaleyyii M23 gidduutti walii galtee tasgabbii uumuuf qaamni gamaggamu tokko naannicha ga'eera. Qataariin kan gidduu galte ta'us, naannoo qabeenya uumamaa qabu kibba Kivu keessatti waraanni ammayyuu itti fufee jira. Gareen haaraan kun gam lamaaniis kan of keessatti qabatu yoo ta'u, walii galtichi akka kabajamu hordofuu fi darbiiwwan raawwataman sakatta'uuf itti gaafatamummaa qaba.

title: Displaced Palestinian builds mud shelter as tents offer little relief
english: A displaced Palestinian man has constructed a traditional mud-brick home to provide better protection for himself and his friends. This move comes as a response to the severe lack of adequate shelter in Gaza and the ongoing difficulty of obtaining standard building materials due to strict Israeli regulations. The mud structure offers a more durable alternative to the flimsy tents that fail to shield against harsh weather and potential gunfire.

title: Why do US elections cost so much money?
english: US election campaigns have become increasingly expensive, with spending rising from under $1 billion before 2010 to nearly $5 billion for the 2024 cycle. Much of this money comes from corporations and special interest groups seeking to shape public opinion through aggressive advertising and media campaigns. While significant funding often correlates with electoral success, occasional upsets occur where candidates win despite being heavily outspent.

title: Ex-Liverpool star Fabinho reunited with Mohamed Salah at Trabzonspor
english: Former Liverpool midfielder Fabinho has signed a two-year contract with the Turkish club Trabzonspor. This move reunites him with his ex-teammate Mohamed Salah, who also recently joined the team. Fabinho expressed excitement about playing alongside Salah again after their successful five-year tenure together at Liverpool.

title: Washington Post ordered to rehire Karen Attiah after Charlie Kirk posts
english: An independent arbitrator has ruled that the Washington Post must rehire columnist Karen Attiah and provide her with back pay. The arbiter determined that the newspaper did not have a valid reason to fire her following her social media posts about the death of Charlie Kirk. Attiah expressed relief at the decision, stating that it confirms her firing was unjust and that she was simply fulfilling her professional duties as an opinion writer.
amharic: ገለልተኛ አገናኝ ዳኛ የዋሽንግተን ፖስት ጋዜጣ አምደኛዋን ካረን አቲያን ወደ ሥራዋ እንድትመለስና የኋላ ደመወዝ እንድትከፍላት ወስኗል። ዳኛው ጋዜጣው አቲያን በቻርሊ ኪርክ ሞት ዙሪያ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በሰጠችው አስተያየት ለማባረር በቂ ምክንያት እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል። አቲያ የዚህ ውሳኔ መብለጥ ለፍትህ መቆሙንና መባረሯ ትክክል እንዳልነበረ ያረጋገጠ በመሆኑ መደሰቷን ገልጻለች።

Attiah murticha kana erga dhageessisee booda, murtichi hojii irraa ari'amuu ishee sirrii akka hin taane kan mirkaneessuufi hojii ishee guddina garaa ishee irratti kanneen hordofan akka ta'e dubbatteetti.

title: Mexico’s president condemns governor’s brief return to office
english: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum has publicly criticized Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya for his short-lived return to office while facing serious US drug-trafficking charges. Rocha, who initially stepped down for over three months, resumed his position briefly before requesting another leave of absence following backlash from his own political party. The president labeled his actions reckless and inappropriate, emphasizing that the interests of the nation must always take priority over personal agendas.

title: Yemen’s Houthis report attack on Saudi ship
english: The Houthi rebel group in Yemen has claimed responsibility for a ballistic missile strike against a Saudi Arabian oil tanker named Amzan near the port city of Yanbu. The ship's operator, Bahri, confirmed that an incident took place but reported that all crew members are safe and unharmed. This attack is part of a series of recent Houthi strikes against Saudi vessels, raising concerns about regional stability and the flow of energy supplies.
